build_index_ngrams_decont: build a decontamination index using NGramsDecontIndexer with lighteval tasks and output folder
filter_contaminated_documents: filter contaminated documents using NGramsDecontFilter with a prebuilt n-gram decontamination index
configure_ngrams_decont: configure NGramsDecontConfig with n_grams, find_query_ngrams, and find_overlap_ngrams settings
test_label_only_decontamination: test label-only n-gram decontamination by setting find_query_ngrams and find_overlap_ngrams to false
test_query_decontamination: test query n-gram decontamination by enabling find_query_ngrams and disabling find_overlap_ngrams
